text:
Maya Patel: FYI — Avenport just confirmed they'd like a hard go-live window next Tue. Procurement wants per-token pricing + a written note on egress controls and SSO timeline before they sign. Can we triage blockers?

Ricardo Chen: I can handle the SSO and egress note. We support SAML + SCIM. Need Avenport's IdP metadata and the list of IPs they need whitelisted for peering.

Sarah Li: For VPC peering we need a signed network addendum + account numbers. If we get those today we can schedule peering in 48h, otherwise it's ~5 business days.

Tom Brooks: @Maya OK — Procurement asked about committed discount tiers too. They want a model that drops unit price at 1M tokens/mo. Do we have a draft pricing table I can share?

Maya Patel: I have a sketch but want ops/legal to confirm before I send. @Jules can you confirm whether the DPA language covers cross-region egress and KMS BYO?

Jules Moreno: Short answer: DPA covers EU/NA egress but customer key BYO (KMS) needs a standard addendum + a simple attestation. I can draft a one-paragraph attestation by EOD. No major legal blockers.

Ricardo Chen: Draft egress/control snippet for procurement (copyable):
```
Redwood Inference confirms network egress can be restricted to customer CIDR ranges via VPC peering and NAT gateway rules. No customer data is stored outside the specified regions. Customer-managed KMS is supported via our KMS integration; keys never leave the HSM.
```

Sarah Li: Also: perf note — if they plan sustained 200 RPS gen traffic, we recommend dedicated pool (reserved capacity). That affects pricing and SLA.

Tom Brooks: OK taking two asks for the exec sync: 1) confirm committed pricing tiers (Maya + finance), 2) legal attestation + addendum (Jules), 3) peering timeline & IP list (Sarah + Avenport). I'll schedule a 30m bridge with their CTO + our CRO if we can get at least items 1+2 by EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Avenport exec bridge" 30m at 2025-03-18T15:00:00Z (created by Tom Brooks).

Maya Patel: Great. Action items: Ricardo send SSO metadata template to Avenport now, Sarah confirm peering SLA, Jules draft attestation, Tom hold exec time slot. I'll update Procurement once we have the signed addendum & the draft pricing table. :thumbsup:

Ricardo Chen: Sending SSO template to the customer now.

Sarah Li: I'll try to move peering up to 48h pending their network addendum — ping me the account IDs when you have them.

Jules Moreno: Drafting attestation now, will post a short note here when done.

Tom Brooks: If anyone needs me to join the procurement thread to explain the dedicated vs hosted tradeoffs I can.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — will follow up here with the procurement email once we have attachments.
